properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (PyCryptodome Crypto.Hash.keccak, digest_bits=256) hashes the EdgeX auth message (timestamp+method+path+params) before ECDSA-secp256k1 signing via SigningKey.sign_digest (:343) — EdgeX/StarkEx-style request authentication per the official EdgeX SDK. Keccak-256 itself is a preimage-resistant hash (Grover square-root only, not Shor-broken); the classical part of the chain is the secp256k1 signature, inventoried separately. All three sites are one op chain inside _generate_signature.
